definitions.gloss: to develop (a disease); to show symptoms; to onset
definitions.explanation: For a disease or medical condition to begin manifesting symptoms. The subject is typically a person, and the focus is on the appearance of symptoms rather than the cause.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}が{発症|はっしょう}する。
{感染|かんせん}から{数日後|すうじつご}に{発症|はっしょう}した。
examples.english: Symptoms appeared several days after infection.

examples.japanese: {花粉症|かふんしょう}は{春|はる}になると{発症|はっしょう}する{人|ひと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many people develop hay fever when spring comes.

notes:
Used specifically in medical contexts to describe the onset of symptoms of a disease or condition. The noun form {発症|はっしょう} is also commonly used on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {病気|びょうき}を{発症|はっしょう}する: to develop a disease
- {症状|しょうじょう}が{発症|はっしょう}する: symptoms appear
- {発症|はっしょう}{時期|じき}: time of onset
- {発症|はっしょう}{率|りつ}: incidence rate
- {発症|はっしょう}リスク: risk of developing (a disease)
- {発症|はっしょう}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent onset

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {発病|はつびょう}する: to fall ill — similar meaning but slightly older/more literary; {発症|はっしょう} focuses on symptom appearance
- かかる: to catch (a disease) — everyday word for getting sick; less clinical
- {罹患|りかん}する: to be affected by (a disease) — more formal/medical, focuses on contracting rather than symptom onset

REGISTER:
Formal/medical. Standard in news reports, medical documents, and health discussions. In casual conversation, people more often say {病気|びょうき}になる.
